CustomDeployment

CustomDeployment is a lightweight quality-of-life mod for

Starsector 0.98a-RC8

.

It keeps the vanilla deployment dialog while adding deployment presets, class-based selection controls, and fleet sorting tools.

Download

Deployment Presets

Save, restore, and manage ship selections directly from the vanilla deployment dialog.

Save and apply up to five deployment presetsRestore the previous initial deployment with LASTAutomatically restore the previous deployment with AUTO LASTContinue editing the selection manually after applying a presetSelect or clear all deployable frigates, destroyers, cruisers, or capital shipsClear the current deployment selectionHover feedback and tooltips for overlay controls

Deployment Controls

LAST — Apply the previous initial deployment1–5 — Apply a preset, or save to that slot while SAVE mode is activeAUTO LAST — Automatically apply the previous deployment when the initial deployment screen opensFRIG / DEST / CRUS / CAP — Toggle all deployable combat ships of that hull sizeCLR — Clear the current deployment selection

Fleet Sorting

Adds sorting controls to the player Fleet screen while keeping the existing fleet interface.

SIZE — Sort combat ships by hull sizeDP — Sort by deployment point cost, highest firstCR — Sort by readiness and combat readinessNAME — Sort by ship nameVAN — Restore Starsector's default fleet sortingREV — Reverse the selected custom sortFLAG — Keep the flagship at the beginning of the fleetMOTH — Keep mothballed ships at the end

Starsector 0.98a-RC8No external library dependencies

The deployment UI integration relies on version-specific Starsector internalsMods that replace or heavily modify the deployment dialog or Fleet UI may not be compatible

descriptionHtml:
CustomDeployment

CustomDeployment is a lightweight quality-of-life mod for Starsector 0.98a-RC8.

It keeps the vanilla deployment dialog while adding deployment presets, class-based selection controls, and fleet sorting tools.

Download


Deployment Presets

Save, restore, and manage ship selections directly from the vanilla deployment dialog.

  • Save and apply up to five deployment presets
  • Restore the previous initial deployment with LAST
  • Automatically restore the previous deployment with AUTO LAST
  • Continue editing the selection manually after applying a preset
  • Select or clear all deployable frigates, destroyers, cruisers, or capital ships
  • Clear the current deployment selection
  • Hover feedback and tooltips for overlay controls

Deployment Controls

  • LAST — Apply the previous initial deployment
  • 1–5 — Apply a preset, or save to that slot while SAVE mode is active
  • AUTO LAST — Automatically apply the previous deployment when the initial deployment screen opens
  • FRIG / DEST / CRUS / CAP — Toggle all deployable combat ships of that hull size
  • CLR — Clear the current deployment selection


Fleet Sorting

Adds sorting controls to the player Fleet screen while keeping the existing fleet interface.

  • SIZE — Sort combat ships by hull size
  • DP — Sort by deployment point cost, highest first
  • CR — Sort by readiness and combat readiness
  • NAME — Sort by ship name
  • VAN — Restore Starsector's default fleet sorting
  • REV — Reverse the selected custom sort
  • FLAG — Keep the flagship at the beginning of the fleet
  • MOTH — Keep mothballed ships at the end


Requirements

  • Starsector 0.98a-RC8
  • No external library dependencies


Compatibility Notes

  • The deployment UI integration relies on version-specific Starsector internals
  • Mods that replace or heavily modify the deployment dialog or Fleet UI may not be compatible


Early Test Release

This is an early test release.

Please include the relevant logs and reproduction steps when reporting issues, especially when using:

  • Unusual battle types
  • Large fleets
  • High UI scaling
  • Custom ships or heavily modified fleet compositions

Changelog

0.1.1
  • Added a LunaLib option to disable Fleet Sorting
  • This can be used to avoid UI conflicts with mods such as SweetFleet

0.1.0
  • Initial release
